title: Triangulated Low Climbing Dome
description: One original fixed low dome visual prop, built from three staggered eight-node rings, a crown node and 64 individually connected rods around 40 genuinely open triangular windows. Twenty-five faceted junction nodes and eight finite stepped ground feet create a complete connected support graph. Each trimmed rod end enters its own node, while separate rods remain separated. No platform, floor, solid roof, slide, swing, person, mat or scene. Separate closed editable meshes, four solid PBR materials, no textures or external dependencies. Metres, Z up, ground-centre origin. One complete dome counts as one prop. Only this fixed visual geometry is checked. No climbability, interaction, human fit, child age suitability, load bearing, fall zone, entrapment protection, anchoring, wind resistance, engineering, installation or playground/child safety certification is claimed.
